notes: forward_offset = prev_page.offset of the first descending page, taken when index collection started (= feed_head_date_modified). It is deliberately EARLIER than max_date_modified: tender documents were downloaded up to ~1.5h after the feed head, so a tender fetched early and changed later would be missed with a later cursor. Every feed entry returned is newer than feed_head_date_modified; entries already in tenders.csv must be upserted by tender_id. Follow next_page.uri of each response to keep polling; an empty page returns the next_page.offset to resume from. Equivalent alternative: offset=<ISO date or unix timestamp> on the ascending feed (also verified).
